hf: Title lockup: Higgsfield MCP × Claude, OPUS 5.5, 'for Motion Design' pill. Jungle with flowers in the foreground, light streak, parallax.
se: Title lockup: SUPERCAR EXPERIENCE, big 'F1 WEEKEND', 'for Las Vegas' pill. Huracán STO parked outside a Vegas building at night, light streak sweep, parallax push.

hf: Establishing shot of the jungle, slow push-in.
se: Establishing: the Sphere glowing over the Strip, slow push-in.

hf: Hero climbs a log beside a waterfall (action intro).
se: Action intro: the STO cruising the Strip at night.

hf: Hero checks phone. iMessage bubble pops in: 'Need a motion promo video. ASAP.' with timestamp and 'Client' label.
se: POV hands on the wheel. Bubble pops in: 'Need a supercar for F1 weekend. ASAP.' from Client.

hf: Insert: hands open the backpack.
se: Insert: hand presses the STO's start button.

hf: Pixel-art cat mascot pops in. Floating words: 'What is it this time?'
se: Original pixel mascot REV (a tiny pixel supercar) pops in. Floating words: 'What is it this time?'

hf: Mascot morphs to a 3D cube ('Objects?') then a triangle ('Shapes?'). Hero gestures.
se: REV morphs into a pixel coupe silhouette ('Coupe?') then a wedge ('Spider?').

hf: Pixel fire bursts into a fireball ('VFX?'). Whole shot color-grades warm, sparks fly.
se: Pixel flames burst off REV ('Launch?'). Shot grades hot orange, sparks fly.

hf: Pixel-font code floats in: 'time * 60 / wiggle(2,10)' ('Expressions?').
se: Pixel code floats in: 'rpm * 9000 / launch(3.0)' ('Specs?').

hf: Mascot returns. Stacked words 'Wait / No / Let me explain'. Prompt bar slides up and types 'I need a promo. Fast. No mistakes.' Send button glows.
se: REV returns. 'Wait / No / Let me book it'. Prompt bar types 'I need a car for F1 weekend. Fast. No mistakes.'

hf: White screen: spark icon + 'Promo brief received. Starting with the reserve logo.' typed with a soft fade.
se: White card: SE mark + 'Booking request received. Starting with the race-weekend badge.'

hf: Editor view: green blob badge with a glowing pixel ring, then zooms out into the comp; badge builds layer by layer.
se: Editor view: SE race badge assembles (rings, rays, checkered flag, monogram) inside a glowing pixel ring, then zooms out to the editor window.

hf: Editor timeline: colored layer bars stack in.
se: Editor timeline: colored layer bars stack in, playhead scrubs.

hf: Badge + speech bubble 'HI, I'M ARA!' pop beside hero in the comp window, mascot waves.
se: Badge + bubble 'HI, I'M REV! Ask me about the fleet.' pop over the footage window.

hf: Hero runs through the forest with a laptop. Prompt types 'Create visual assets for Ivayu Reserve.'
se: 750S blasts through the desert. Prompt types 'Pull the fleet for race weekend.'

hf: White card: 'Creating photos, pins, and badges…' + tool chip 'Generating visuals for Ivayu Reserve.'
se: White card: 'Pulling cars, specs, and rates…' + chip 'Building cards for the Las Vegas fleet.'

hf: Whip pan into the editor's project panel (asset list).
se: Whip into the project panel: file list cascades in.

hf: Asset board: badge, rotating sunburst, photo frame, pin, path line, terrain tile pop in.
se: Asset board: rotating sunburst, car card, pin, route line, gauge, checkered tile pop in.

hf: Timeline zoom: keyframe dots streak across colored tracks.
se: Timeline zoom: keyframe dots streak across tracks.

hf: Hero crosses a rope bridge (monkeys chase). Prompt: 'Make a map showing how to get to the reserve.'
se: Purple Urus on a desert road. Prompt: 'Map the drive from pickup to the Strip.'

hf: Close-up shout, word 'route!' pops.
se: Rally driver selfie (slowed to half speed), ROUTE! slams in.

hf: Insert: feet on the bridge planks.
se: Insert: low wheel shot on the road line.

hf: White card: 'Mapped. Five stops. One route. Walking times included.'
se: White card: 'Mapped. Five stops. One route. Drive times included.'

hf: Illustrated island map builds: river draws, trails draw, landmarks pop.
se: Illustrated Las Vegas valley island builds: Strip line draws, Lake Mead fills, Red Rock rises, landmarks pop.

hf: White card chip: 'Generating photos of the trail stops…'
se: White card chip: 'Generating photos of every stop…'

hf: Map with title 'SUN GATE TRAIL', pins drop, photo cards pop around, cursor clicks.
se: Map titled 'RACE WEEKEND ROUTE': pins drop, photo cards pop, cursor clicks.

hf: Arrow whips past; hero ducks.
se: Semi-truck whips past the GT3 RS.

hf: Hero against a stone wall with laptop. Prompt: 'Create a visual of the reserve's landmark.'
se: GT3 RS tracking shot. Prompt: 'Create a hero poster of the GT3 RS.'

hf: Glow ring reveals the landmark photo inside a custom frame shape.
se: Glow ring reveals the GT3 RS inside a custom frame shape.
note: Uses stills from public/stills, not a plate.

hf: Poster: 'THE SUN GATE' types on, body copy, tags, thumbnails pop, badge stamps.
se: Poster: 'THE GT3 RS' types on, specs, tags, thumbnails pop, SE badge stamps.
note: Uses stills from public/stills, not a plate.

hf: Giant boulder behind hero. Prompt: 'Render the final and send it to the client!'
se: Truck closes in on the GT3 RS. Prompt: 'Render the final and send it to the client!'

hf: Hero escapes the boulder.
se: AMG GT Black Series pulls out of the night, fast.

hf: Hero catches breath; phone bubble: 'Looks great! Next brief: a safety video for the reserve.'
se: SF90 at golden hour. Bubble: 'Looks perfect! Booked. Next: the whole crew for the rally.'

hf: Hero walks off, mascot hops along. CTA line: 'Try Higgsfield MCP for motion design…'
se: STO under the lights, REV hops along. CTA: 'TEXT OR DM TO BOOK · (725) 425-3583 · SUPERCAREXP.VIP'

hf: End card: Instagram glyph + @HIGGSFIELD.AI, glyph color-shifts.
se: End card: SE logo + @supercar_experience_, logo shimmer, 21+ line.
